sources.owner: The Be Book class index, Be Inc. API reference, preserved by the Haiku Project

window_frame.note: Charts, Browser, Pulse, and Backgrounds preserve the gray two-stage frame, hard edge, corner, and shadow.

title_bar.note: The yellow leading title tab is preserved at native scale and intentionally covers only the title width.

window_buttons.note: Charts and Preferences preserve compact raised tab-local close/zoom plates and one-bit figures.

toolbar.note: The Browser crop preserves a dense menu bar, URL row, icon commands, rules, and scroll adjacency.

buttons.note: Backgrounds preserves enabled and disabled raised buttons with hard BeOS relief.

choice_controls.note: Backgrounds preserves pop-ups, disabled value wells, a checkbox, and colour sliders at native scale.

fields.note: Backgrounds preserves inset numeric fields, value wells, and framed colour-preview fields.

menus.note: The native Deskbar crop preserves the open Be menu's header, clock row, icon rows, compact spacing, hard outline, and square panel geometry; selected and cascading states remain unrecorded.

popovers.note: The Be Book class index, Be's own complete API reference, lists no tooltip, tip, hint, balloon or transient-help class in any kit, so R5 shipped no standard hover surface; Threading should carry the same information in a BAlert-shaped panel rather than invent a BeOS bubble.

scrollbars.note: Browser preserves the exact 12×200 repeated-arrow control: two 15px Up/Down pairs, a 15px gripped thumb, continuous white page rail, #F0 track, and #98 pair divider.

lists_tables.note: Preferences preserves icon rows while Browser preserves document/list boundaries and scrollbar seating.

progress.note: Pulse preserves the compact segmented status/gauge anatomy used for BeOS progress-like feedback.

alerts_toasts.note: The Be Book's own BAlert figure preserves a complete native alert at 350x79: hard two-stage outer frame, the darker left icon band carrying the 3D info glyph, single-line message, and a right-aligned Cancel/Don't Save/Save row whose default button wears an extra outline ring.

typography.note: Backgrounds, Browser, and Preferences preserve Swiss/Helvetica-like text at native scale.

icons.note: Preferences preserves the colourful 32px device/control-panel icon family and underlined labels.

tolerance.method: Full-crop native-1x RGB RMSE after exact 111×19 size validation, plus pixel review of the flat #FFCB00 tab, its lemon/ochre/gray edge rails, both 14×14 indexed-palette caption plates, and centred title metrics. Every non-type pixel is identical; the remaining error is limited to current macOS Helvetica rasterization because BeOS's proprietary Swis721 BT face is not installed or redistributed.

reproductions.note: Production WindowTitleBandView renders the corrected tight 111×19 title tab. Both yellow caption gadgets and every band/edge pixel are identical; the installed Helvetica fallback is tracked and optically offset to Swis721 BT's native title bounds, with only the documented glyph-raster residual remaining.

tolerance.method: Full-crop native-1x RGB RMSE after exact 12×200 size validation, plus native-pixel review of both repeated 15px arrow pairs, the 15px value-zero thumb and inset square, the 124px exposed page region, continuous white leading rail, and #989898 pair divider.

reproductions.note: Production ThemedScroller renders the corrected tight 12×200 control extraction. Both duplicated Up/Down pairs, the minimum proportional gadget, every track and rail pixel, and the pair divider are pixel-identical to Browser; the wider crop remains supporting context for its three-row toolbar seating and seven-row client continuation.

Production ThemedCheckbox family based on Haiku's pinned MIT BeControlLook implementation and the native disabled checked box in Backgrounds: compact white nested wells and a two-pixel system-colour X, kept distinct from Workbench's gray recessed tick gadget. The source crop includes adjacent popup furniture, so this remains a family review rather than an exact reconstruction.
